node.statement: This step explicitly depends on node 1.2: once node 1.2 is validated, its statement gives r_star in C. For distance to a set, D = dist_1(p,C) is the infimum of ||p-y||_1 over y in C, so every particular y in C satisfies D <= ||p-y||_1. Applying this to y = r_star gives D <= ||p-r_star||_1.
